# [Mandatory] KBYG ProductLed Summit
Date: 2026-09-16 | Duration: 28m

## Summary
The team organized Product Led Summit operations, with Jake and Scott handling booth setup Monday from 3 to 5 pm and Ashley bringing giveaway assets and completing tablecloth and iPad setup Tuesday at 8 am. Booth 22 is an 8x8-foot space with power and Wi-Fi, while Liz will coordinate Wednesday teardown and UPS pickup. At least two people must staff the booth during show hours: 8 am to 5 pm on day one and 8 am to 4 pm on day two. The team aims to capture 60 scan leads from 150 to 200 attendees, with 40% matching the ICP and target job titles, conduct five short demos, book three live sales demos, and schedule 10 ICP meetings after the event. Lead scanning will use one iPad mini with the Acara app and a $450 license; personal phones are not permitted. Leads and conversation notes must be exported and sent to Lyndsie for HubSpot import. The booth will feature a banner, monitor, swag, QR-code handouts, and a Terracafe TK Demi coffee machine giveaway. Expenses must be submitted to Jennifer, with Lyndsie CC’d, within one week after the event.

## Keywords
lead scanning, booth setup, event logistics, product summit, swag giveaway, demo bookings

## Action Items

**Lyndsie Berens**
Provide iPad Apple ID and password to the team as needed for lead scanning app access (00:07)
Send out details and instructions for using the Acara lead scanning app and the process for exporting lead data post-event (00:07)
Receive exported lead data from the iPad after the event and upload it to HubSpot for lead management (00:15)
Monitor event expenses and track reimbursements, ensuring Jennifer is copied on all expense reports (00:11)
Coordinate shipping of the iPad after the event if Ashley cannot return it to the office, ensuring proper handling and tracking (00:06)
Share dress code details and event communication links with the team to ensure everyone is informed and prepared (00:03)
Assist with any onsite issues reported by Jake or Scott during booth setup to ensure smooth preparation (00:03)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Act as onsite lead during the event, managing booth operations and coordinating team activities (00:03)
Bring tablecloth, iPad with lead scanning app, and giveaway assets to the booth on Tuesday morning for setup and event use (00:03)
Retain and charge the lead scanning iPad overnight during the event and handle export of recorded leads at event end (00:07)
Hand out giveaway traffic driver postcards with QR codes to event attendees to encourage booth visits and raffle participation (00:08)
Submit expense report within one week post-event, copying Jennifer and Lyndsie for tracking and reimbursement (00:11)

**Jake Stangl**
Arrive Monday around 11:30am to begin booth setup including unpacking packages and setting up the monitor and demo equipment (00:11)
Test monitor and demo USB drives including adapters and power strip included in the supply kit to ensure all equipment functions properly (00:11)
Confirm all shipped packages have arrived and report any missing items immediately to Lyndsie for resolution (00:03)

**Graham McNicoll**
Arrive Tuesday morning to provide booth coverage and support demos alongside Ashley, ensuring continuous presence and engagement (00:03)
Participate actively in handing out giveaway cards and conducting booth demos to maximize attendee engagement and lead generation (00:08)
